stem: In the sensitisation phase of an allergic response, which T cells communicate with B cells after allergen presentation by macrophages?
explanation: T_H2 T-cells are the helper T-cell subset that communicates with B cells during sensitisation to promote IgE-mediated allergic responses.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because T_H2 T-cells provide the helper signals to B cells after allergen presentation, driving the allergic sensitisation pathway.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because mast cells are effector cells that act during allergic reactions, not the cells that direct B-cell class switching in sensitisation.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because red blood cells do not have an immune-signalling role in allergic sensitisation.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because neutrophils are not the main T-cell subset responsible for communicating with B cells in allergy development.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because eosinophils are inflammatory effector cells and do not provide the key helper signal to B cells in sensitisation.

source.hint: Identify the specific subset of Helper $\text{T}$-cells involved in allergic pathways.
